How to play

Add a task, then swipe the ball forward and release. Your speed at release sets its momentum. A slow roll may stop short; a fast one can overshoot.

Finish the revealed task to bank its points. A miss earns 10 points. Bank all points marks all rolled tasks complete and collects their points. Unrolled tasks stay in your rack.

Your first throw each local calendar day banks a flat 50 points and keeps your streak going. Task completion points get +0.1× per consecutive day: 1× on day 1, up to 2× on day 11. The 50-point bonus is never multiplied. Missing a day resets the multiplier; your wallet and cosmetics stay.

Spend banked points in the cosmetic shop. Your total earned score stays the same when you spend. Everything saves in this browser on this device.
